title: Sweet orange and clove simmer pot
subtitle: A warming stovetop blend with Christmas spice notes
excerpt: A stovetop simmer pot of orange slices, whole cloves, cinnamon sticks, star anise, and vanilla pod in water. A warming, spiced scent that fills the kitchen and living room. Particularly good in autumn and winter. Simmer for 1-3 hours, topping up with water as needed. Ingredients for one pot.
sourceNotes: Simmer pot with spice volatiles: eugenol (cloves/allspice) at low concentration from simmering water, warming, familiar, low-irritant at these dilutions. Cinnamaldehyde (cinnamon sticks): sweet-spicy volatile, released slowly from bark in hot water. Limonene (orange peel): evaporates quickly; the citrus note is strongest in the first 30 minutes. Vanillin (vanilla pod): released from split pod into hot water; very low threshold odour compound, small amount creates a strong impression. Star anise (trans-anethole): anise-sweet note. Together: warming spiced citrus blend. Caution: do not leave simmering unattended; do not let the pot boil dry.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Combine all ingredients in the pot and refrigerate up to 24 hours before simmering. Discard after use.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Use the day of simmering. Discard botanicals after use; they will mould if stored wet.

glossaryTerms.definition: A pot of water with whole botanical ingredients simmered on the hob to release volatile aromatic compounds. A low-cost, chemical-free alternative to synthetic air fresheners.

content.text: is a warming spiced-citrus blend for the hob, orange slices, cloves, cinnamon, star anise, and vanilla simmered in water. The orange note is strongest at the start; the spices carry longer. The kitchen and adjoining rooms fill quickly. A particularly good scent in autumn and winter. Simmer for 1-3 hours; never leave unattended. Ingredients for one pot.

items.prepNote: in a small saucepan on the lowest heat; top up as needed
large; sliced into rounds; skin on
approx. 1 tbsp, 15 whole cloves; warm spice foundation
adds sweet warmth and a woody note
split lengthways; releases vanilla fragrance gradually

content.text: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce to the lowest heat that maintains a gentle simmer. Leave the lid off.
Top up with water every 30-45 minutes. Never allow the pot to boil dry. Simmer for 1-3 hours then remove from the heat. Discard the contents.
